device.model: UWSim cirs.xml scene with girona500 vehicle
device.name: UWSim underwater simulator

facts.text: The simulator defaults to data/scenes/cirs.xml and initializes the ROS node as UWSim.
The main loop runs at 60 Hz, sets the ROS interface time from ros::Time::now(), spins callbacks, steps physics when enabled and draws a frame every iteration.
The default scene declares ROSTwistToPAT for the girona500 vehicle on the absolute /g500/twist topic.
ROSTwistToPAT subscribes to geometry_msgs/TwistStamped on its configured topic.
ROSTwistToPAT::processData translates and rotates the vehicle by linear and angular twist times the wall-clock elapsed time since the previous message.
ROSInterface.h defines MAX_ELAPSED as 1, commented as the maximum time in seconds between two consecutive control references.

processData uses zero elapsed time for the first message and whenever more than 1 s of wall time passed since the previous message, and applies one translation and rotation of twist times that elapsed time per message.
The default scene also declares ROSPoseToPAT on /g500/pose for the girona500 vehicle.
ROSPoseToPAT subscribes to geometry_msgs/Pose and sets position and orientation directly.
The default scene declares ROSJointStateToArm on /uwsim/joint_state_command for the girona500 vehicle.
ROSJointStateToArm subscribes to sensor_msgs/JointState and calls setJointPosition or setJointVelocity depending on which array is nonempty.
The default scene declares ArmToROSJointState on the absolute /uwsim/joint_state topic.
ArmToROSJointState advertises sensor_msgs/JointState, fills name and position, pushes effort 0 for every joint and leaves velocity empty.
ROSSceneBuilder advertises the relative SpawnMarker service.
The underwater_vehicle_dynamics dynamics node advertises the /dynamics/reset std_srvs/Empty service.
The /dynamics/reset callback sets velocity and pose back to their initial values and returns; it does not touch the thruster setpoint u.
UWSim_g500_dynamics.launch starts the g500 dynamics node, uwsim with the cirs.xml scene and keyboard.py publishing to /g500/thrusters_input.
dynamics.launch passes /<namespace>/pose as the dynamics node's default output topic.
The dynamics node publishes the vehicle pose from a rospy.Timer every uwsim_period.
dynamics_g500.yaml sets g500/dynamics/uwsim_period to 0.001.
keyboard.py publishes a five-element thruster array every 0.1 s, zeros unless a key is pressed, and calls /dynamics/reset on the space key.
stopROS calls ros::shutdown while ROS is ok, and stopAll flushes the network simulator log and calls stopROS.
The SIGTERM callback calls stopAll.
The default scene declares RangeSensorToROSRange on the absolute /uwsim/g500/range topic at rate 10.
RangeSensorToROSRange advertises sensor_msgs/Range and publishes the measured distance in range and the configured sensor range in max_range.
The default scene declares ImuToROSImu on the relative g500/imu topic.
ImuToROSImu advertises sensor_msgs/Imu and fills the orientation quaternion and the orientation covariance diagonal; angular_velocity and linear_acceleration remain the message defaults.
The default scene declares PressureSensorToROS on the relative g500/pressure topic.
PressureSensor::getMeasurement returns the z translation in the localized world frame plus Gaussian noise.
PressureSensorToROS::publish copies getMeasurement() into the pressure field of an underwater_sensor_msgs/Pressure message.
The default scene declares VirtualCameraToROSImage for camera bowtech1 on /uwsim/camera1 and /uwsim/camera1_info.
VirtualCameraToROSImage advertises an image_transport image and a sensor_msgs/CameraInfo and sets the image encoding to 32FC1 for a depth camera, mono8 for a black-and-white one and rgb8 otherwise.
The uwsim package declares the licence GPL.
uwsim/license.txt is the GNU General Public License version 3.

determinism.notes: Event-driven rosbridge fake with no physics step, integration, wall-clock pacing or state-hash replay; the observations are canned placeholders

gaps: the fake is a ROS-free recording transport: it answers the declared /g500/twist publication and the /uwsim/joint_state and /uwsim/g500/range subscriptions, but runs no UWSim, OSG, Bullet physics, scene or wall-clock loop
the twist publication is transmission only; the fake does not integrate it and cannot show that the simulated vehicle moved or stopped
the joint names, joint positions and range values are placeholders; a live run must receive them from the operator's UWSim scene and pinned uwsim node
the default cirs.xml scene has no PATToROSOdom output, so no vehicle pose or odometry topic is bound from that scene
the /g500/pose and /uwsim/joint_state_command control inputs are NOT COVERED; this package binds only the vehicle twist control
the camera image and CameraInfo topics, range camera, IMU, pressure/depth, DVL, GPS, multibeam LaserScan, force, echo, contact and TF outputs are NOT COVERED
the IMU and pressure topics are configured as relative names (g500/imu and g500/pressure) in the scene XML; this package does not invent a resolved absolute spelling for them

uwsim's only ROS service is SpawnMarker (scene markers, not a stop); the optional underwater_vehicle_dynamics node adds /dynamics/reset, which keeps the thruster setpoint (dynamics.py:249-252, :323) and is not a stop either

model review: a single publication moves nothing when it is the first message on /g500/twist or comes more than 1 s after the previous one (ROSInterface.cpp:166-176), so isolated MHS invocations do not move the vehicle; in the shipped UWSim_g500_dynamics.launch the dynamics node publishes /g500/pose every 1 ms, which ROSPoseToPAT applies directly, and keyboard.py publishes thrusters every 0.1 s, both competing with the twist input
the main loop has no pause flag; closing the viewer or SIGTERM calls stopAll and shuts down ROS, which is process shutdown, not a source-backed ROS stop binding

safe_state.description: No acknowledged stop: uwsim has no stop, pause or reset service or action, and the optional dynamics node's /dynamics/reset restores pose and velocity but keeps the thruster setpoint. Each /g500/twist message moves the vehicle once (twist times the wall time since the previous message), so after the latch no MHS message moves it, but nothing acknowledges that, and other publishers on /g500/twist, /g500/pose and the arm command topic are not fenced.
